Description: Private repository this AMP runner is allowed to serve, in owner/name form. Required. Use one AMP instance per runner worker; multiple workers may register to the same repository and share labels.

One-hour self-hosted-runner registration token copied from GitHub repository Settings > Actions > Runners > New self-hosted runner. Needed only for first registration (or recovery after local runner state is lost). Clear this field after the runner reports Ready. This is not a PAT.
Comma-separated custom labels GitHub workflows use to target this worker. GitHub also adds self-hosted, Linux, and X64 automatically. Workers in the same pool should use identical labels.
Human-readable prefix for this persistent repository-scoped worker. A stable per-instance id is appended automatically, so workers in a pool may safely share a prefix.
Runner release used only for initial installation. latest is recommended. The registered runner then uses GitHub's normal automatic runner updates.

Optional operator-controlled base64 encoding of a JSON array describing immutable HTTPS tool archives. Every entry pins name, version, platform, exact archive size, SHA-256, archive type, unpacked-size ceiling, and optional executable paths. Leave empty when this worker needs no persistent trusted tools.
Maximum versions retained per trusted tool/platform group, including the currently configured version. Two keeps the current version plus one previous version when available.
Delay before starting the next single-job listener after surviving job processes and filesystem state have been scrubbed and trusted tools reverified.
